phase0_history.design: dropped the external P4 dependency entirely; data_capture_root/data_captured_receipt derived from the same publish_v2 manifest/receipt bytes (raw_proof_bytes[9]/[11]) that also produced the supplied capability; capability proven to belong to that exact root by minting a second capability from the same (raw_proof, raw_proof_bytes) and requiring both capabilities' projected envelope bytes exactly equal before either is used
